verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.jitsu.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that describes Jitsu, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Doc pages are also served as raw Markdown (.md variants for MCP, API, CLI, Functions SDK, webhook and HTML tracking docs), which gives agents a machine-friendly entry point. Missing for 10: evidence of how complete the llms.txt index is (the probe output is truncated) and first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/Markdown docs as an agent-facing feature.
